note: Root observations frozen before independent review dispatch for the named case; candidate findings, not runtime failures or reviewer ground truth.

candidateFindings.location: State ownership and persistence; Errors, interruption and recovery; Resume/Discard draft
candidateFindings.trigger: Recovery-draft autosave is queued, then ordinary Discard draft/Discard changes occurs without a global reset; delayed writer runs afterward.
candidateFindings.consequence: Document checks store generation and revision but does not explicitly retire the individual discarded draft or require writers to check active eligibility, so discarded work can reappear as recovery data.
candidateFindings.counterevidence: Non-reused practice identity, version-aware save cleanup, generation checks and atomic reset are explicit. They do not by themselves specify ordinary per-draft discard eligibility.
candidateFindings.correction: Resolve individual draft retirement or equivalent exclusion at the write authority, including queued writers and failure behavior. Do not impose an unnecessary global reset.

openQuestions: Finish A while note B is typed preserves B, but repeated Finish with the same practice ID returns the existing completion. Resolve B's next useful action or choose a bounded immutable Finish interval if the current wording leaves it stranded. Check counterevidence before treating as defect.

candidateFindings.location: Hosted checkout handoff and unknown outcomes
candidateFindings.trigger: Two successful observations of the same checkout action arrive out of order, including old pending evidence or an obsolete ready-session URL after newer confirmed evidence.
candidateFindings.consequence: Action/cart correlation and preserving failed-lookups do not define same-action successful evidence ordering or unorderable contradiction, permitting regression or an obsolete resume target.
candidateFindings.counterevidence: Stable identity, duplicate/terminal/recovery contracts and current-cart navigation guards are specified; observation freshness remains separate.
candidateFindings.correction: Require contract-defined evidence ordering/finality and URL lifetime; retain history, reject proven stale replacements and expose unorderable conflicts without dispatching overlapping effects.

candidateFindings.location: Cart ownership and durable recovery; Start a new saved cart
candidateFindings.trigger: An earlier queued writer remains eligible when an explicit reset creates replacement saved authority with reused revision values.
candidateFindings.consequence: Revision checks alone lack an explicit non-reused authority identity or equivalent reset exclusion, so old intent may overwrite the new saved cart.
candidateFindings.counterevidence: Transactions, serialized snapshot saves and a required successful explicit reset are specified. A preserved monotonic revision could suffice, but its reset behavior is not resolved.
candidateFindings.correction: Specify reset invalidation or equivalent non-reused authority/revision rule for every writer; verify before claiming a stale-write failure.

openQuestions: Adding an existing variant says add/merge but leaves combined quantity/key semantics terse; quote revalidation gates actual purchase, so distinguish a bounded clarification from an unsafe checkout claim.
Appearance write errors fall back to System. Clarify whether a failed preference write preserves an explicit current-visit Light/Dark choice rather than disabling it while storage is unavailable.
Service ordering and partial outcomes are explicitly a live-enable contract gate; inspect whether any downstream promise bypasses it before treating unspecified ordering as a document defect.

Translation delivery selects complete static version-matched packs before entry, with immediate language changes. Do not impose asynchronous request-generation machinery solely from historical cases that chose dynamic loading.
bilingual-service.coverage: Full first draft read before independent review dispatch. Major task, branch/review/history, memory-only draft, exact focus, static language and remote recovery gates are concrete proposals; no runtime evidence.
